facts.business: Ashoka Metcast Limited is engaged in trading of steel and metal products and provides loans to related parties, with a subsidiary Rhetan TMT Limited in the TMT bar manufacturing business.
key_risks: Related party transactions with enterprises significantly influenced by KMP
Loans to subsidiary and related parties
facts.related_party_note: Transactions with related parties include remuneration to KMPs, loans to/from directors and subsidiary Rhetan TMT Limited, and transactions with enterprises significantly influenced by KMP such as Lesha Industries Limited, Lesha Ventures Private Limited, Gujarat Natural Resources Limited, and Ashnisha Industries Limited.
